For the purposes of this regulation, the professional qualification shall include membership of Institute of Chartered Accountants of India, Institute of Company Secretaries of India, Institute of Cost Accountants of Ind

An entity seeking registration as a FME shall at all times comply with the net worth requirements as specified in Second Schedule of these regulations or such other amount as may be specified by the Authority

An entity operating as a branch shall at all times comply with the minimum net worth requirements specified in these regulations for its activities in IFSC which may be maintained at the level of the parent entity
The applicant and its principal officer, directors/ partners/ designated partners, key managerial personnel and controlling shareholders shall be fit and proper persons, at all times

A Venture Capital scheme shall not have more than fifty (50) investors
Provided also that the minimum investment threshold specified above shall not apply to an Accredited Investor

Explanation.- A Registered FME intending to launch Venture Capital Schemes to target more than fifty (50) investors or pool money from investors investing with lower application size of USD 150,000 shall be able to do so
(1) A Venture Capital scheme shall only be a close ended scheme
(2) The amount to be raised under a Venture Capital scheme and the tenure of the scheme, which shall not be less than three (3) years, shall be disclosed in the placement memorandum
(1) In case of Venture Capital schemes, the minimum size of the corpus shall be USD 3 Million, and the total corpus shall not exceed USD 200 Million

(1) The placement memorandum for Venture Capital schemes shall clearly include disclosures regarding the investment objective, the targeted investors, proposed corpus, investment style or strategy, investment methodology
(2) The FME shall ensure that the Net Asset Value (NAV) is disclosed to the investors at least on a yearly basis within such time period as disclosed in the placement memorandum of the scheme
The FME shall ensure that the portfolio under the scheme is disclosed to the investors at least on a yearly basis and not later than one (1) month of the end of each financial year
Any other material disclosure, as considered suitable by the FME or the fiduciaries, shall be informed to the investors immediately
The FME and fiduciaries shall comply with the disclosure requirements as may be specified by the Authority
The maximum leverage by the scheme, along with the methodology for calculation of leverage, shall be disclosed in the placement memorandum
The FME and fiduciaries shall ensure compliance of investment valuation norms, as specified in the Sixth Schedule

Explanation II.- Venture capital funds under this Part shall not be required to comply with conditions specified for Venture Capital schemes as specified under Part A of Chapter III of these regulations

attestations.label: Whether the Policy on Complaint Handling and Grievance Redressal is in place
The FME is in compliance with the requirements for disclosures to the investors under IFSCA (Fund Management) Regulations, 2025.
The FME is in compliance with Investment Valuation Norms as specified in Sixth Schedule of IFSCA (Fund Management) Regulations, 2025.

The distributors appointed by FMEs are in compliance with the code of conduct prescribed under the IFSCA (Capital Market Intermediaries) Regulations, 2025 and circulars / guidelines, etc. issued thereunder, as may be amended from time to time.
The FME and its operations in IFSC are in compliance with the IFSCA (Fund Management) Regulations, 2025 and the circulars / guidelines etc. issued thereunder.
The Net worth requirement has been complied with at all times during the reporting period.

The FME has the necessary infrastructure like adequate office space, equipment, communication facilities and manpower to effectively discharge its activities. The infrastructure requirements are commensurate to the size of its operations in IFSC as required under Regulation 10 of IFSCA (Fund Management) Regulations, 2025.

The FME, its fiduciaries, KMPs (including Principal officer, Fund Managers and Designated Compliance Officer) are in compliance with the Code of Conduct as specified in Third Schedule of IFSCA (Fund Management) Regulations, 2025.
